# Lionheart Fixt 0.11.0 - The Prisoner of Montserrat

Montserrat is an invasion, and it should be one. What it lacked was any way through it that was
not a fight against every pack in turn. Now there is one, and it is the game's own idea: the
garrison wants the Scion alive. So give yourself up at the gate.

Your steel is taken -- named weapons come back exactly, the rest as plain blades. You wake in
the abbey's undercroft, a new map, with a handler outside the cell and five ways out: the lock,
the pins, the handler's own weakness, the escort, or the drain an old monk tells you about. Out
quietly and the abbey treats you as a delivery; out loud and it hunts you. Sahar has three ends
now, and the third is her ring and her word north -- worth exactly one abbey, and read three
different ways by three people who know whose mark it is.

Also: the trolls' ore chest has an owner, and the Grove's wasp nest has a queen.

**Fixt** is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. Montserrat needs a character who has never entered it.
The gate, the cell and the hall were played as they were built; Sahar's prisoner talk and the
rout are built and unplayed -- what you find goes into 0.11.1.
